test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To the manner born

options.text: To do something as though it is coming naturally
To give a ride to someone

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "To the manner born" is taken from Shakespeare's play **'Hamlet'.**
 
• It means to be accustomed to certain behaviors or practices from birth, or to perform actions as if they are natural or inherent.(स्वाभाविक रूप से कुछ करने के लिए)
